name: TM7 Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: Brown butter, cooled and solidified (made from 226 g unsalted butter; use all of it, including the browned milk solids)

steps.text: If needed, chill the browned butter until solidified but still soft enough to cream. Use all of the browned butter, including the browned milk solids.
Add all of the cooled, solidified brown butter to the mixing bowl. Mix 1 min / speed 4. Scrape down the sides and base of the bowl, then mix again 1 min / speed 4 until creamy.
Add 200 g soft dark brown sugar and 100 g caster sugar. Mix 1 min 30 sec / speed 4. Scrape down if needed.
Add 1 large egg, 1 large egg yolk and 10 g vanilla extract. Mix 30 sec / speed 4. Scrape down the bowl, then mix 15 sec / speed 4.

Add 313 g plain flour, 5 g cornflour, 5 g bicarbonate of soda and 3 g fine sea salt. Mix 20 sec / speed 4. Scrape right down to the base of the bowl, then mix 10 sec / speed 4, stopping as soon as no obvious dry flour remains.
Add 30 g room-temperature whole milk and mix 10 sec / speed 3.5.
Add 200 g chocolate chips and mix 15 sec / reverse / speed 2.5. If needed, finish folding the last few chips through with the spatula rather than overmixing.
Divide the dough into approximately 45 g portions. Shape each portion slightly tall rather than perfectly round and place on a lined tray.
Cover and refrigerate the shaped cookie dough for at least 2 hours, or up to 3 days.
When ready to bake, preheat the oven to 190°C conventional / 170°C fan. Line baking trays with baking paper.
Arrange about 8 chilled cookies per tray, leaving plenty of space between them. Sprinkle with flaky sea salt if using.
Bake for 12-14 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden but the centres still look soft and slightly underdone.
Leave the cookies on the hot baking tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool.
